_: THE ROSTER OF CAPTAINS — who can be hired, world-wide (docs/SKILLS_AND_CAPTAINS.md §4, K4). The ONE authored list of the people: 0015 seeded eight, 0073 forty-three, 0098 twelve (their rows in data/npc-houses.json `lesser_officers` are that shipped generator's input, never re-read), and 0156 adds forty-two so that every one of the 25 jobs has at least two captains (D15). scripts/build-captains.mjs derives each captain's grade, ten traits and languages from this file and data/captains.json; scripts/db/world-guard.mjs holds public.officers to this file on every apply.
_shape: `specialty` is her JOB — a trait code of data/captains.json (the table column keeps its name until K9). `bonus_pct` is her job's value, which also sets her grade (D10). The Inn derives who is present from (captain, port, quarter hour, world secret) — never rolled and stored.
